title: Fix Google Merchant Center permission issues
excerpt: Resolve common permission problems when connecting Google Merchant Center.
author: FeedOps
content:
Permission issues usually mean the signed-in Google user cannot grant FeedOps the access it needs.

## Check access

- Confirm the user is added to the Merchant Center account.
- Confirm the account is not a duplicate or old Merchant Center profile.
- Ask an admin to grant product data and feed management access.

## Reconnect

After permissions are corrected, disconnect Google Merchant Center in FeedOps and connect it again.
